title: Block catalog: blocks.json
description: The block types the template editor offers, in the order its Add a block list shows them: what each is called and is for, and which rules the checks bring to it. Read by Neelam.Campaigns.BlockCatalog at startup with System.Text.Json, which also checks what a schema cannot (every block type in code has one entry, every rule named is one the checks report). This schema is checked by the tests only.

type.description: The block type in code (BlockType), by name, such as FinePrint.

label.description: What the editor calls the type, also the usual label of a new block.

description.description: What the block is for, in plain language, under its name in the editor.

rules.description: The rule ids the checks bring to this block, in the order their lines are shown under What the checks look for.

wording.description: This block's own words for some of its rules, said once in place of their descriptions in rules.json.
